title: What If Humans NEVER INVENTED CLOTHES?
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
description:
What if humanity never invented clothing? No shirts, no shoes, no hats, not even a single sock.
In this alternate timeline, our ancestors find animal fur about 170,000 years ago, look at it for a moment and simply walk away. That one small decision changes almost everything. Civilization squeezes into a thin warm strip around the equator. Cities are built entirely around shade. Sunscreen shops replace clothing stores, and status comes from jewelry, body paint and very expensive hairstyles. With no pockets, people carry baskets, and the rich use trained squirrels. Without textile mills the Industrial Revolution could slow down, and without spacesuits the Moon stays untouched.
Then one cold morning Kevin ties two leaves together, and the world is never the same again.
Would you survive one day in a world where nobody invented clothes? Tell us in the comments! 👇

title: What If Humans Never Invented Clothes
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
description:
What if humans never invented clothes? 🧥 No shirts. No socks. No pockets. Everyone just wears body paint, and one weird kid sews the first hoodie in human history. The internet calls him "Burrito Boy"... until a freak blizzard hits a school trip and his bag of hoodies is the only thing that can save 40 kids. ❄️

Real facts in this video:
⚡ Scientists dated clothing with lice DNA: body lice split from head lice 83,000-170,000 years ago
⚡ Humans are the "naked apes," with 2-4 million sweat glands
⚡ Hypothermia starts when your body temperature drops below 95°F
⚡ When you STOP shivering, hypothermia is getting dangerous
⚡ At a wind chill of -18°F, exposed skin can get frostbite in 30 minutes or less (National Weather Service)
⚡ Water pulls heat from your body about 25x faster than air, so stay dry

Would YOU have worn the first hoodie, even if everyone laughed? Comment below 👇 and subscribe for a new What If every week. No cap.

title: What If Everyone Who Ever Died Came Back to Life?
tags: what if everyone who ever died came back
what if the dead came back to life
what if dead people came back
how many people have ever lived
description:
Your grandma is at the door. Behind her: every human who has ever died. All 109 billion of them.
What happens to food, houses, the law - and democracy - when the dead outnumber the living 13 to 1?

About 117 billion people have ever been born, and only about 8 billion are alive today. Shoulder to shoulder, all of them would fit inside Belgium - but the world only keeps a few months of grain in storage. Half of the returned were born before the year one, tens of billions are kids, Genghis Khan has around 16 million male-line descendants, and in 2013 an Ohio judge told a living man he was still legally dead. So what would 109 billion returned people do with a vote?

title: What If Humans Had to Live Without Clothes Forever?
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
what if we never wore clothes
description:
What if humans never invented clothes? Would we still survive, or would the world become a completely different place?

Imagine a world where nobody wears shirts, pants, shoes, or jackets. No fashion industry, no shopping malls, and no winter jackets. Sounds simple, right? But what if something as ordinary as clothing is actually one of the most important inventions in human history?

In this Suppose What If video, we explore what would happen if humans had never invented clothes. From extreme weather and human evolution to survival, society, relationships, and everyday life, discover how different our civilization might have become.

Clothing isn't just about fashion. Scientific research suggests that humans began regularly wearing clothing tens of thousands of years ago, potentially as early as 170,000 years ago. Researchers have even studied the evolution of body lice to investigate when our ancestors started wearing clothes!

But without this invention, would humans have survived the Ice Age? Would we have developed different bodies? And would modern civilization look anything like it does today?

Watch until the end to discover how one missing invention could completely change humanity.

Subscribe to Suppose What If for more mind-blowing What If scenarios, science experiments, human evolution, and animated explanations.

title: What If Humans Never Created Clothes?
tags: what if humans never invented clothes
what if there were no clothes
when did humans start wearing clothes
description:
What if humans never invented clothes? You wake up tomorrow, reach for the sock drawer… and there is no sock drawer.

In our world, our ancestors started wearing clothes somewhere between 83,000 and 170,000 years ago, and we know it partly thanks to lice DNA. In this world, it never happens. Below roughly 27°C an unclothed body burns extra energy just to stay warm, so humanity gets stuck in one thin warm belt around the equator. No Ice Age Europe. No Siberia. Probably no Americas.

Then the sun becomes the real enemy. Cities grow roofs on top of roofs, shade stores replace clothing stores, and a poor guy named Gus falls asleep on a park bench and wakes up with a barcode tan.

We follow the whole chain reaction: offices with no dress code, a world with no pockets (except one very suspicious goat), dating with nothing to hide, no textile mills and no Industrial Revolution as we know it, and astronauts who can't go to space because a space suit is… clothing.,,,,,, hopefully you like my hardwork and dont forget to like comment and share ,,

And then one chilly morning, someone has an idea.

Would you survive one day in this world? Tell me in the comments 👇
